reviews.title: Another winner by ASUS
reviews.comment: ASUS continues to manufacture products that knock it out of the park, and the ROG Gladius III gaming mouse is no exception! When my Gladius II started going awry, I opted for a replacement/upgrade, and I must say... I'm quite the satisfied customer. It's about 10-15% smaller than my previous mouse, and it lacked the rubber grip, but it's still pretty dang easy to keep my hand on it during those more intense gaming sessions. Also, I feel like the fact that it weighs a tad less than my previous mouse, makes it all the more beneficial for MMO gaming. To sum it up, with this being a tad more economical than my previous mouse (also got it when it was on sale), I can definitely say this is the best mouse I have owned.
reviews.author: Zachary Dolle
